parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Ethanedioic acid, $\text{C}_2\text{O}_4\text{H}_2$, occurs in many vegetables. The amount that occurs in spinach can be estimated as follows.

• $40.0\text{ g}$ of spinach leaves are crushed and mixed with distilled water, using a mortar and pestle.
• The mixture is filtered, and the leaves are washed with a little more water.
• The combined filtrate and washings are made up to $100.0\text{ cm}^3$ with water.
• A $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ portion of the resulting solution is added to a conical flask, along with an excess of dilute sulfuric acid.
• The acidified solution is warmed, and then titrated with $0.0200\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{KMnO}_4$.

The equation for the reaction between ethanedioic acid and acidified manganate(VII) ions is shown.

$$2\text{MnO}_4^- + 6\text{H}^+ + 5\text{C}_2\text{O}_4\text{H}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{Mn}^{2+} + 10\text{CO}_2 + 8\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

In the titration, $15.20\text{ cm}^3$ of $\text{KMnO}_4$ was required to reach the end-point.

Calculate the percentage by mass of ethanedioic acid in the spinach leaves.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Ethanedioic acid can be converted into ethanedioyl chloride:

$$\text{HO}_2\text{CCO}_2\text{H} \rightarrow \text{ClOCCOCl}$$
parts.text: State a suitable reagent for this reaction.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Explain what the rest of the carbon-13 NMR spectrum indicates about the structure of **L**.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
When pure **L** is reacted with an excess of $\text{CH}_3\text{OH}$, a mixture of three compounds is formed.

$$\begin{matrix} \mathbf{L} & \text{and} & \text{CH}_3\text{OH} & \rightarrow & \mathbf{M} & \text{and} & \mathbf{N} & \text{and} & \mathbf{O} \\ (\text{C}_4\text{O}_6) & & & & (\text{C}_2\text{H}_2\text{O}_4) & & (\text{C}_3\text{H}_4\text{O}_4) & & (\text{C}_4\text{H}_6\text{O}_4) \end{matrix}$$

**M** is formed as one of the products when either **N** or **O** is heated with aqueous acid.

The table gives information of the peaks recorded in the carbon-13 NMR spectra of **M**, **N** and **O**.

| compound | peaks recorded in carbon-13 NMR spectrum |
| :--- | :--- |
| **M** | $\delta$ 162 |
| **N** | $\delta$ 53 $\delta$ 160 $\delta$ 162 |
| **O** | $\delta$ 53 $\delta$ 160 |
